annotations.title: Top up Sepolia test ETH from an agent or CI job: 0.1 SepETH per call

description: Use when an agent, test suite or CI job needs Sepolia gas now: one x402 call, no faucet login or mainnet history. Input: to (recipient address); sends 0.1 SepETH (1 SepETH: /v1/testnet/sepolia-eth/1). Output: JSON txHash (confirmed before settling), explorerUrl, amountEth, from, to. Daily limits (UTC): 5 SepETH per address (both sizes), 20 overall; checked before payment. Test ETH has no monetary value. Use instead: sepolia_eth_1 for 1 SepETH per call; base_sepolia_eth for Base Sepolia instead of Ethereum Sepolia. Example: ?to=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD Price: $0.05 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

to.description: Recipient Ethereum address (EIP-55 checksum if mixed case). Bad input, caps reached or out of stock → 4xx/503 before payment (not charged)
